```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(scales)

root_dir <- if (dir.exists("TA_functions")) "." else if (dir.exists("../TA_functions")) ".." else "../.."
source(file.path(root_dir, "TA_functions", "TA_functions.R"))

simulation_dir <- if (dir.exists("Simulation_Scenario_B")) "Simulation_Scenario_B" else ".."
data_dir <- file.path(simulation_dir, "data")
image_dir <- file.path(simulation_dir, "images")
results_dir <- file.path(simulation_dir, "results")
dir.create(image_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Configuration

```{r configuration}
simulation_start <- as.Date("2015-01-01")
simulation_end <- as.Date("2024-12-31")
training_end <- as.Date("2021-12-31")
test_start <- as.Date("2022-01-01")

n_groups <- 20
n_rules <- 3
replication_seeds <- 1001:1100
lift_metric <- "rmse"

param_grid <- expand.grid(
  cp = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.005),
  minbucket = seq(4, 8, by = 1),
  maxdepth = seq(4, 8, by = 1),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

lunar_new_year_dates <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "lunar_new_year_dates.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(lunar_new_year = as.Date(lunar_new_year))
```

## Data-Generating Process

```{r functions}
nearest_lunar_new_year <- function(dates, lunar_dates) {
  date_differences <- outer(
    as.numeric(dates),
    as.numeric(lunar_dates),
    FUN = "-"
  )
  nearest_index <- apply(abs(date_differences), 1, which.min)
  date_differences[cbind(seq_along(dates), nearest_index)]
}

lunar_new_year_effect <- function(days_from_lunar_new_year, event_shocks) {
  pre_holiday_peak <- ifelse(
    days_from_lunar_new_year >= -14 & days_from_lunar_new_year <= -1,
    34 * (1 + days_from_lunar_new_year / 18),
    0
  )
  holiday_dip <- ifelse(
    days_from_lunar_new_year >= 0 & days_from_lunar_new_year <= 7,
    -42 * (1 - days_from_lunar_new_year / 16),
    0
  )
  post_holiday_rebound <- ifelse(
    days_from_lunar_new_year >= 8 & days_from_lunar_new_year <= 16,
    16 * (1 - (days_from_lunar_new_year - 8) / 14),
    0
  )

  (pre_holiday_peak + holiday_dip + post_holiday_rebound) * event_shocks
}

generate_lunar_calendar_demand <- function(seed, lunar_dates) {
  set.seed(seed)
  dates <- seq.Date(simulation_start, simulation_end, by = "day")
  days_from_lunar_new_year <- nearest_lunar_new_year(dates, lunar_dates)

  annual_pattern <- 4 * sin(2 * pi * yday(dates) / 365.25) +
    2 * cos(2 * pi * yday(dates) / 365.25)
  weekday_pattern <- c("1" = -4, "2" = -2, "3" = 0, "4" = 1,
                       "5" = 3, "6" = 7, "7" = 4)[as.character(wday(dates))]
  event_shocks <- rnorm(length(lunar_dates), mean = 1, sd = 0.08)
  nearest_event_index <- apply(
    abs(outer(as.numeric(dates), as.numeric(lunar_dates), FUN = "-")),
    1,
    which.min
  )
  lunar_effect <- lunar_new_year_effect(
    days_from_lunar_new_year,
    event_shocks[nearest_event_index]
  )
  innovations <- as.numeric(arima.sim(model = list(ar = 0.45), n = length(dates), sd = 5))

  tibble(
    Time = dates,
    Value = 160 + annual_pattern + weekday_pattern +
      lunar_effect + innovations,
    Day = day(dates),
    Week = ceiling(day(dates) / 7),
    Month = month(dates)
  )
}

fit_lunar_scenario_arima <- function(train_values) {
  forecast::auto.arima(
    y = ts(train_values, frequency = 7),
    seasonal = TRUE,
    stepwise = TRUE,
    approximation = TRUE
  )
}

make_lift_plot <- function(data, prediction_column, evaluation_label) {
  lift_data <- tree_alert_lift_data(
    df = data,
    actual_col = ".resid",
    pred_col = prediction_column,
    n_groups = n_groups,
    lift_metric = lift_metric
  )

  ggplot(lift_data, aes(x = group, y = meanError)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4C78A8") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#B2182B", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, n_groups, by = 2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 6), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = "Ventile", y = "Lift") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey92"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90")
    )
}

interpret_lunar_rule <- function(raw_rule) {
  text <- raw_rule
  text <- gsub("Week", "week of month", text)
  text <- gsub("Month", "Gregorian month", text)
  text <- gsub("Week", "ISO week of year", text)
  text <- gsub("Day", "day of month", text)
  text
}

run_tree_alert_replication <- function(seed, save_representative_outputs = FALSE) {
  analysis_data <- generate_lunar_calendar_demand(seed, lunar_new_year_dates$lunar_new_year)
  train_raw <- filter(analysis_data, Time <= training_end)
  test_raw <- filter(analysis_data, Time >= test_start)

  arima_model <- fit_lunar_scenario_arima(train_raw$Value)
  train_raw$.fitted <- as.numeric(fitted(arima_model))
  train_raw$.resid <- train_raw$Value - train_raw$.fitted

  test_forecast <- as.numeric(forecast::forecast(arima_model, h = nrow(test_raw))$mean)
  test_raw$.fitted <- test_forecast
  test_raw$.resid <- test_raw$Value - test_raw$.fitted

  train_set <- train_raw %>% filter(is.finite(.resid))
  test_set <- test_raw %>% filter(is.finite(.resid))
  tree_formula <- .resid ~ Day + Week + Month

  grid_search <- tree_alert_grid_search(
    train_set = train_set,
    formula = tree_formula,
    param_grid = param_grid,
    n_groups = n_groups,
    pred_col_name = "Tree_Prediction",
    lift_metric = lift_metric
  )
  best_params <- grid_search$best_params
  tree_model <- tree_alert_train_best_model(train_set, tree_formula, best_params)

  train_set$Tree_Prediction <- as.numeric(predict(tree_model, newdata = train_set, type = "vector"))
  test_set$Tree_Prediction <- as.numeric(predict(tree_model, newdata = test_set, type = "vector"))
  train_lift <- tree_alert_compute_lift_numeric(
    train_set, ".resid", "Tree_Prediction", n_groups, lift_metric
  )
  test_lift <- tree_alert_compute_lift_numeric(
    test_set, ".resid", "Tree_Prediction", n_groups, lift_metric
  )

  tree_rules <- rpart.plot::rpart.rules(tree_model, cover = FALSE, digits = 4, nn = FALSE)
  rule_selection <- tree_alert_pull_top_k_rules(tree_rules, n_rules = n_rules)
  raw_rules <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(rule_selection$selected_rules)),
    function(i) tree_alert_format_rule_raw(rule_selection$selected_rules[i, ]),
    character(1)
  )
  replication_result <- tibble(
    seed = seed,
    cp = best_params$cp,
    minbucket = best_params$minbucket,
    maxdepth = best_params$maxdepth,
    train_first_ventile_lift = train_lift,
    test_first_ventile_lift = test_lift
  )

  if (save_representative_outputs) {
    full_data <- bind_rows(train_set, test_set) %>% arrange(Time)
    flag_cutoff <- quantile(train_set$Tree_Prediction, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
    plot_window <- full_data %>%
      filter(Time >= as.Date("2022-01-01"), Time <= as.Date("2022-03-31")) %>%
      mutate(Flagged = Tree_Prediction >= flag_cutoff)

    forecast_plot <- ggplot(plot_window, aes(x = Time)) +
      geom_line(aes(y = Value, color = "Actual"), linewidth = 0.65) +
      geom_line(aes(y = .fitted, color = "ARIMA forecast"), linewidth = 0.65) +
      geom_point(
        data = filter(plot_window, Flagged),
        aes(y = Value),
        shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "#B2182B", size = 2.4, stroke = 0.9
      ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = as.numeric(as.Date("2022-02-01")),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "#555555", linewidth = 0.7) +
      annotate(
        "text", x = as.Date("2022-02-01"), y = Inf,
        label = "Lunar New Year", vjust = 1.4, hjust = 0.5,
        size = 4.3, color = "#333333"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "#4C78A8", "ARIMA forecast" = "#E17C05")) +
      scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 weeks", date_labels = "%b %d") +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Daily demand", color = NULL) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
      theme(
        legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98),
        legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.85), color = "grey70"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )

    ggsave(file.path(image_dir, "scenario_b_forecast_flags.png"),
           forecast_plot, width = 10, height = 5.5, dpi = 1000)
    ggsave(file.path(image_dir, "scenario_b_lift_train.png"),
           make_lift_plot(train_set, "Tree_Prediction", "Training"), width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 1000)
    ggsave(file.path(image_dir, "scenario_b_lift_test.png"),
           make_lift_plot(test_set, "Tree_Prediction", "Test"), width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 1000)

    write_csv(full_data, file.path(data_dir, "scenario_b_actual_forecast_series.csv"))
    write_csv(
      tibble(raw_rule = raw_rules, interpretation = vapply(raw_rules, interpret_lunar_rule, character(1))),
      file.path(results_dir, "scenario_b_representative_rules.csv")
    )
  }

  replication_result
}
```

## Representative Simulation

```{r representative, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
representative_result <- run_tree_alert_replication(1001, save_representative_outputs = TRUE)
representative_result
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(image_dir, "scenario_b_forecast_flags.png"))
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(image_dir, "scenario_b_lift_train.png"))
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(image_dir, "scenario_b_lift_test.png"))
```

## Monte Carlo Lift Sensitivity

```{r replications, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
replication_results <- bind_rows(lapply(replication_seeds, run_tree_alert_replication))
write_csv(replication_results, file.path(results_dir, "scenario_b_replication_results.csv"))

lift_summary <- replication_results %>%
  summarise(
    replications = n(),
    train_median = median(train_first_ventile_lift),
    train_iqr_lower = quantile(train_first_ventile_lift, 0.25),
    train_iqr_upper = quantile(train_first_ventile_lift, 0.75),
    train_min = min(train_first_ventile_lift),
    train_max = max(train_first_ventile_lift),
    test_median = median(test_first_ventile_lift),
    test_iqr_lower = quantile(test_first_ventile_lift, 0.25),
    test_iqr_upper = quantile(test_first_ventile_lift, 0.75),
    test_min = min(test_first_ventile_lift),
    test_max = max(test_first_ventile_lift),
    test_lift_above_one_pct = mean(test_first_ventile_lift > 1) * 100
  )
write_csv(lift_summary, file.path(results_dir, "scenario_b_lift_summary.csv"))

boxplot_data <- replication_results %>%
  select(seed, Training = train_first_ventile_lift, Test = test_first_ventile_lift) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-seed, names_to = "Evaluation", values_to = "Lift") %>%
  mutate(Evaluation = factor(Evaluation, levels = c("Training", "Test")))

monte_carlo_plot <- ggplot(boxplot_data, aes(x = Evaluation, y = Lift, fill = Evaluation)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#B2182B", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.58, outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "white", linewidth = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Training" = "grey75", "Test" = "#4C78A8")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 6), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "First-Ventile Lift") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 17) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(image_dir, "scenario_b_monte_carlo_lift.png"),
       monte_carlo_plot, width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 1000)

lift_summary
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(image_dir, "scenario_b_monte_carlo_lift.png"))
```
